title: Standing orders and recurring account instructions
workflow: Authorize and record customer recurring mandate
Validate account, beneficiary and transaction limits
Derive deterministic occurrence ID from approved schedule
At due time revalidate mandate, restrictions and available funds
Submit one idempotent payment instruction and retain outcome evidence
Advance schedule only under approved recorded completion/exception semantics
invariants: Scheduler replay must not debit twice
Cancelled or expired mandate cannot execute new occurrence
Payment network acceptance is not finality
Unknown external outcome must remain investigable before retry
Insufficient funds policy is bank-configured and audited
Mandate revisions preserve past authorizations and executions
planned_tests: Timer fires twice and yields one occurrence
Unknown external result does not blindly resubmit
approval_gate: Bank recurring-payment policy, approved mandate and payment rail entitlement plus reliability tests.
